mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressures that lead to tighter monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE falls below 5% and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 increases for two consecutive quarters and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO YoY growth is less than -2% and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases and UNRATE decreases simultaneously, and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC for this interaction remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 50 basis points in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5% in a month and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a robust labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases simultaneously, and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC for this interaction remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real disposable personal income (RSAFS) over two consecutive quarters signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for two consecutive quarters and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
